decisions.rationale: Pay stub gross and YTD are partly illegible, NOA 2025 ($136,100) is below the stated $139,500 and predates the May 2026 start with this employer, so current income cannot be clearly verified.

Appraisal value of $454,000 (approved Summit panel) is subject to roof replacement completion and no completion certificate is on file, so the condition is not cleared.
